title: Bloomberg News Article
description: Schema for a Bloomberg news article delivered through the Bloomberg News API or BLPAPI //blp/mktdata and //blp/refdata news services, representing breaking news, analysis, and multimedia content covering global markets and business.

storyId.description: Unique Bloomberg identifier for the news story

headline.description: Primary headline of the news article

subHeadline.description: Secondary headline or deck providing additional context

summary.description: Brief summary or abstract of the article content

body.description: Full text body of the news article

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the article was first published

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the article was last updated

url.description: Canonical URL of the article on Bloomberg.com

authors.description: List of authors who contributed to the article

source.description: Originating news source or wire service

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the article

wordCount.description: Total word count of the article body

urgency.description: News urgency classification reflecting the BLPAPI NEWS_STORY_URGENCY field

topics.description: Bloomberg topic codes and categories associated with the article

securities.description: Securities mentioned in or related to the article, referenced by Bloomberg identifiers

regions.description: Geographic regions relevant to the article

sectors.description: Industry sectors relevant to the article content

tags.description: Free-form tags or keywords associated with the article

media.description: Associated multimedia content such as images, videos, or charts

relatedStories.description: References to related Bloomberg news stories

storyId.description: Bloomberg story identifier of the related article

copyright.description: Copyright notice for the article content

Author.description: A Bloomberg news article author or contributor

bio.description: Short biographical description of the author

url.description: URL to the author's Bloomberg profile

Topic.description: Bloomberg topic classification for news categorization

SecurityReference.description: A reference to a financial security mentioned in the article, using Bloomberg security identification conventions

ticker.description: Bloomberg ticker symbol in TICKER MARKET_SECTOR format

MediaAttachment.description: Multimedia content associated with the article

caption.description: Caption or description for the media asset

credit.description: Attribution credit for the media asset

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media content
